title: STM32_Programmer_CLI: ST-LINK error when using JLINK
content:
After updating to STM32CubeProgrammer v2.22.0, I get the following error when connecting with JLINK:

Error: ST-LINK interface not available

My commands still work, but they just print this error message everytime. Is this a known issue, and are there any ways of suppressing this particular error?

Full trace of a simple command below:

STM32_Programmer_CLI -c port=JLINK sn=xxxxxxxx mode=HOTPLUG -score
      -------------------------------------------------------------------
                        STM32CubeProgrammer v2.22.0
      -------------------------------------------------------------------

Connecting to J-Link/Flasher Probe
Device=Cortex-M33
Device ID   : 0x484
Voltage     : 1.81V
Frequency   : 4000 KHz
Error: ST-LINK interface not available
NVM size  : 2 MBytes
Core is halted

 

Using:

  • STM32CubeProgrammer: v2.22.0
  • STM32H573II
  • SEGGER J-Link PLUS: SEGGER J-Link Commander V8.10c
